narrative: Material PL3__MED63B6C exhibits regular demand patterns with gamma-like distribution characteristics. Over 228 working days, mean daily demand is 464.9 units (CV=0.62). Lead time shows volatile behavior (mean=1.12 days, CV=0.79). The optimized policy recommends a safety stock of 844 units (vs. current 127), an order quantity of 2692 units (EOQ-based, constrained by storage capacity), and a reorder point at 1364 units with a 6-day review period. This optimization achieves the 95% service level target while reducing total annual costs by $65,115.84 (90.5%). The capacity constraint of 3536.3 units limits the order quantity below the unconstrained EOQ of 3393 units. Safety lead time should be increased from 0.0 to 1.8 days.
